note:
An ethanol plant at Stanley, thirty miles east of the Emmert elevators, and a CORN BUYER rather than a co-operative -- fourteen delivery months of corn and nothing else. Built 2026-08-20 from the served HTML Sig pasted; fixtures/ace-3578.html is the excerpt, values verbatim. THE EXISTING cashbidssingle PARSER READS IT UNCHANGED, 14 of 14 rows, which was not a foregone conclusion: Big River renders its rows as a <table> and this vendor renders them as <ul class='sevenColumnsBigFirst'> with li.c1..li.c7, so 'the parser already handles cashbidssingle' was a claim about a URL shape and had to be checked against markup. locationId is null on purpose -- their page carries exactly one location and does not key its rows, which is the case lib/sources.mjs requires to be stated rather than omitted. Their futures column carries a trailing 's' on every row and Last Trade reads 01:20 PM throughout, which is the CME grain settle; tickFlag only recognised that marker on tick-format quotes until this source arrived. STILL DISABLED, and the reasons are listed in _pending.

FUTURES UNITS, MEASURED 2026-09-07 from fixtures/ace-3578.html: this board writes its futures column in DOLLARS per bushel to four places (e.g. "5.3675s"), not in cents or eighths of a cent the way bigriverbids.com writes "459-4". Read as cents every row is out by roughly a hundredfold and the board refuses; read as dollars the rows balance to within a cent, which is the whole slack two-decimal cash and basis columns can produce. Declared, not inferred, and self-checking: a wrong declaration is out by a hundred and the identity guard refuses.

CASH ROUNDING, MEASURED 2026-09-07 across 216 testable rows on the eleven captured dollars-quoting cashbidssingle boards: residuals -0.50 (7), -0.25 (21), 0 (16), +0.25 (140), +0.50 (28), +0.75 (1) and nothing else except Berthold's per-tonne canola. This board posts cash and basis to two decimals and its quote on the quarter-cent grid, so the derived value is a whole number of cents and the quote is not. round-cent-both bounds that at strictly under a cent, which is what two cent-rounded columns can produce between them.
publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the page their own website serves. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.
